cohort: All175625 existing pre-origin nearest-record geodesics; preserve225 candidate and155 modeled species. No selection by forecast errors.
sampling: WGS84 geodesic midpoint samples at <=2km spacing, including one midpoint for zero-length routes. GSHHG high-resolution level1 land mask. Retain count of all and land samples; ocean samples are not zero elevation. This is separate from250m marine-gap and intermediate-island sampling.
DSM: Copernicus GLO90 DSM; use its native pixel values at land sample coordinates, no interpolation or invented missing values. Existing cell sample caches identify previously accessed tiles but do not provide unsampled route elevations.
features: Route land elevation P90 and P90-P10 sampled spread; log1p of values clipped below at0 as numerical transforms. At least3 valid land sample points and >=80% valid fraction of planned land samples required; otherwise numeric placeholders0 with explicit route-terrain-unknown flag. Keep raw quantiles and support fractions.
planned_comparison: B5 plus route P90, spread and unknown flag versus unchanged B5; original full155-species temporal/spatial evaluation, same rows and RF settings. Secondary island summaries explicitly separate. No threshold optimization on heldout outcomes.
limits: 2km samples can miss narrow ridges or islands; quantiles are not full-route extrema, slope, least-cost path or proven mountain resistance. Modern DSM includes buildings/vegetation, not historical terrain. Routes follow nearest past record, not known movement. Acquisition coverage must be audited before model fitting.
